content.title: Pokémon GO March 2026 Community Day Guide
content.text: Content Continues Below Starting in January 2018, Community Day is a monthly event in Pokémon GO that shines the spotlight on a particular Pokémon. For one day each month, a specific Pokémon will have its spawn rate increased during a block of hours. Also, the Shiny appearance rate for the starring Pokémon will be boosted. There are also other perks to Community Day – such as the featured Pokémon knowing at least one exclusive attack through evolution, increased duration for Lure Modules, Event Boxes, and more. While Community Day is only one day a month (typically), Pokémon appearing in Community Days from January to November of the same calendar year will come back in December. The Community Day hosted in December is a two-day event where Community Day Pokémon from the same and previous year will return via Raids, Eggs, and increased spawns. So if you’re unable to partake in a specific Community Day, there’s always another chance to catch that Pokémon again (and its Shiny version)! In addition to that, Community Days of old return with Community Day Classic! Debuting in January 2022, this spin-off event resembled Community Days from 2018, but with some additional event bonuses (namely photobomb encounters). Please note that the Community Day events resemble ones from the first few years of this event. Bonus Raid Battles after Community Day, a “sub-event” which featured special Raid encounters with the Community Day featured Pokémon or its evolution, has been quietly removed (along with Community Day exclusive stickers). Sometimes additional Timed Research will be issued during or right after Community Day and will feature the Pokémon for that month’s Community Day, but it will vary by event. When will Pokémon GO’s March 2026 Community Day take place? March 2026’s Community Day will be happening on Saturday, March 14th, 2026 from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. your local time. What Pokémon is being showcased for March 2026‘s Community Day? The Pokémon featured for this March 2026’s Community Day is Scorbunny. You’ll find that Scorbunny will be appearing more frequently in the wild and, if you’re lucky, you might even encounter a Shiny one! What is the exclusive attack for March 2026’s Community Day? Evolve Raboot into Cinderace (via 100 Scorbunny Candies) and you’ll have a Cinderace that will know Blast Burn (Charged Attack). Blast Burn’s attack stats are the following: Trainer Battles: 120 power Gyms and Raids: 110 power Notes: This attack can only be learned when Raboot is evolved in Cinderace (via 100 Scorbunny Candies) on Saturday, March 14th, 2026 from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m. your local time. Evolution Notes: To evolve Scorbunny into Raboot, it requires 25 Scorbunny Candies. To evolve Raboot into Cinderace, it requires 100 Scorbunny Candies. Therefore, if evolving Scorbunny to Cinderace, a total of 125 Scorbunny Candies is required. Are there any bonuses for March 2024‘s Community Day? Yes, the bonuses for Community Day are: 1/4 Egg Hatch Distance when Eggs are placed in an Incubator during the event period 2× Candy for catching Pokémon 2× chance for Trainers level 31 and up to receive XL Candy from catching Pokemon Lure Modules activated during the event will last for one hour (Golden Lure Module excluded) (active from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m. your local time) Scorbunny will have an increased chance to be Shiny and may have a Special Background during these extended hours Incense activated during the event will last for three hours (Daily Adventure Incense excluded) Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise! (Scorbunny photobomb spawn. Can be repeated up to 5 times.) Trades made will require 50% less Stardust (active from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m. your local time) One additional Special Trade can be made for a maximum of two for the day (active from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m. your local time) This Community Day overlaps with the Pokémon Pokopia Celebration Event. The following bonuses might also be in effect: 2× XP for spinning PokéStops 10× XP for spinning a PokéStop for the first time Increased chance to encounter Shiny Sudowoodo and Shiny Zorua What is the Special Research Story for March 2026‘s Community Day? The Community Day Special Research Story is called Hoppily Ever After. It’s a paid-for quest that costs US$1.99 OR US$2.00 (or the equivalent pricing in your local currency). Tickets can be purchased in-game as well as via the Pokémon GO Web Store through a special bundle. This Special Research can be gifted to Friends who have a Friendship level of Great Friends and higher. (Tickets are nonrefundable (subject to applicable law and the exceptions set forth in the Terms of Service). Please note that this Special Research will not include an in-game medal and will not feature a story.) A complete list of tasks and rewards for this Special Research Story will be added once the event is live. Step 1/3 Task: Catch 3 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 5 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 10 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Make 7 Nice Throws Reward: 20 Ultra Balls Task: Make 5 Great Throws Reward: 1 Incubator Task: Make 5 Curveball Throws Reward: 1 Incense Completion Rewards: Scorbunny* encounter (Special Background guaranteed), 50 Scorbunny Candies, and 5 Scorbunny XL Candies Step 2/3 Task: Catch 3 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 5 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 10 Pokémon Reward: Raboot* encounter Task: Use 3 Berries to help catch Pokémon Reward: 20 Ultra Balls Task: Use 5 Berries to help catch Pokémon Reward: 1 Charged TM Task: Use 7 Berries to help catch Pokémon Reward: 3 Silver Pinap Berries Completion Rewards: Scorbunny* encounter (Special Background guaranteed), 7,500 Stardust, and 3 Rare Candies Step 3/3 Task: Catch 3 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 5 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter Task: Catch 10 Pokémon Reward: Cinderace* encounter Task: Spin 3 PokéStops or Gyms Reward: 20 Ultra Balls Task: Spin 5 PokéStops or Gyms Reward: 1 Rocket Radar Task: Explore 1 km Reward: 1 Premium Battle Pass Completion Rewards: Scorbunny* encounter (Special Background guaranteed), 10,000 XP, and 1 Rare Candy XL Note: Pokémon marked with an * means that “If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!” Will there be any Field Research tasks for March 2026‘s Community Day? For March 2026’s Community Day event, the following Field Research tasks may be available (based on previous Community Day events, guide will be updated once the event is live): Task: Catch 3 Scorbunny Reward: Scorbunny* encounter OR 5 Great Balls OR 2 Ultra Balls OR 2 Pinap Berries OR 500 Stardust Task: Catch 50 Pokémon Reward: Scorbunny* encounter (Special Background encounter guaranteed) Task: Catch 5 Pokémon while in a Party Reward: Scorbunny* encounter (Special Background encounter guaranteed) Note: Pokémon marked with an * means that “If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!” Will there be PokéStop Showcases during March 2026‘s Community Day? No. During the Season of Memories in Motion, the scheduling of PokéStop Showcases shifted to Tuesdays. Thus, the Saturday and Sunday PokéStop Showcase session that would take place during Community Day events will not be happening. Are there any special Raids for March 2026‘s Community Day? For March 2026’s Community Day, there will not be any special bonus Raid battles. Are there any Event Bundles for March 2026‘s Community Day? There will be some event bundles for sale via the in-game shop: Great Box (480 PokéCoins, purchase limit 1): 30 Ultra Balls, 3 Super Incubators, 1 Incense, and 1 Lure Module. Community Day Box (1,350 PokéCoins, purchase limit 1): 50 Ultra Balls, 5 Super Incubators, 1 Elite Charged TM, and 5 Lucky Eggs. There will also be a bundle for sale via the Pokémon GO Web Store: Scorbunny Community Day Ultra Ticket Box (USD$1.99): 1 Ticket (for the paid Community Day Special Research), 5 Ultra Balls, and 24 Reward Points. Are there any special event-themed stickers for March 2026‘s Community Day? No. There will not be any special stickers featuring the Pokémon spotlighted for this Community Day event. Are there any other bonuses/tasks for March 2026‘s Community Day? March 2026’s Community Day overlaps with the Pokémon Pokopia Celebration Event. Bonuses for that event have been included in this guide. For additional information about the event, you can check out our Pokémon Pokopia Celebration Event guide. Also, Community Ambassador Activations will be happening in select cities. For a full list of available locations, you can check out the interactive map on the dedicated Community Day Map page. Interactive maps also include “Community Parks”, but these locations will not have any additional bonuses available. Community Ambassador Activations: Connect with local Community Ambassadors and their communities. Get a special Timed Research when checking in. Community Parks: This park may be a fun place to play with your local community while enjoying some fresh air.
